resources.string: Create multiple instances of an app with separate accounts, data, contacts and files. Each has its own name, icon badge and notifications. App updates apply to every instance. Removing the original also removes its twins. Some apps may restrict multiple accounts or profiles.
No more spaces are available, or your administrator has restricted app twins.
Enter a name of 1–24 characters without control characters.
Another instance of this app already uses that name.
Choose an installed app to create your first independent instance.
All %1$d instances of this app and their accounts, app data and files will be permanently deleted. The original app is unaffected. To keep the data, pause individual instances instead.
Instance unavailable. You can delete it and create another.
Your home app could not add this shortcut.
Stop this instance and its notifications until you open or resume it.
Unlock the device to resume this instance.
Manage permissions, battery use or clear this instance’s data.
All instances use the keyboards enabled and selected in the main space.
Remove only this instance and its data
This permanently removes this instance’s accounts, app data and files. The original and other instances are unaffected.
This instance is no longer available.
No active instance can receive this content. Resume an instance in App twins and try again.
Could not share this content. The attachment may no longer be accessible.
